function letterProgress(L, progress): number

Defined in: website/components/home/mosaic/burn/front.ts:32

A letter's own burn progress — global progress scaled by the letter's speed, shifted by its ignition delay. Letters ignite at different moments and race at different rates, so one glyph can be ash while a neighbour is untouched.

Parameters

L

LetterBurn

The letter's burn unit (speed multiplier + ignition delay).

progress

number

Global burn stage 0..1.

Returns

number
